note: City holiday pages (QUEUE G16 step 4, OWNER D32). One record per event, read on the page named. An event leaves after end_on. Dollar text lives only in cost_*, *_priced and extra fields, which hide once the read is older than 30 days. No year in the URL: refreshed each season.

chicago.check_note: The City of Chicago's pages and the market's dates page didn't open for us, so those dates come from Choose Chicago, the city's tourism board.

why.text: Free on reserved Mondays through Dec 14.

picks.label: Ages 4 and 8 together
picks.why: Skating is in the ticket, and there's more at Navy Pier.

why.text: ZooLights on a reserved Monday, or the free parade day.

picks.label: Cold or wet day
picks.why: Indoor options, from the organizers' pages.

picks.label: Sensory needs
picks.why: Each has one sensory night, dated on its card.

items.text: Holidays @ Skydeck, the Loop: Nov 13 to Jan 4, with Santa appearances
The Joffrey Ballet's The Nutcracker: Dec 4 to 27

events.name: Magnificent Mile Lights Festival
events.place: Michigan Avenue, Oak Street to Wacker Drive
events.dates: Saturday, Nov 21, 2026: daytime fest 11 a.m. to 4 p.m., parade 5:30 p.m., fireworks about 7:15 to 7:30 p.m. (sources differ)
events.cost_note: Free, per the city's tourism board.
kids: Free photos with Santa at the daytime fest, 11 a.m. to 4 p.m.
Parade at 5:30 p.m., so little ones can do the daytime part only
events.watch: Michigan Avenue closes 3 to 7:30 p.m. and some streets from 8 a.m. The organizer says the north end's east side is less crowded. We found no stroller rules.

events.name: Chicago Thanksgiving Parade
events.cost_note: A free parade, per the city's tourism board.
kids: A free street parade, per the tourism board
events.watch: The page we read lists no start time. Check it on the parade's own site.

events.name: Chicago Christmas Tree lighting
events.cost_note: The tourism board lists no cost.
kids: An evening lighting at Millennium Park
events.watch: Check the city's page for the program before you go.

events.name: Christkindlmarket
events.dates: Nov 20 to Dec 24, 2026 (the Wrigleyville market runs to Dec 31)
events.cost_note: The organizer says admission is free.
events.watch: Check hours and stroller rules on the market's site.

events.name: Christmas Around the World
events.place: Griffin Museum of Science and Industry, Hyde Park
events.dates: Opens Nov 7, 2026; the page lists no closing date
events.cost_note: Included in General Admission. The museum's price table didn't read clearly, so check the price on its pricing page. Kids are 3 to 11. No Illinois free days remain in 2026.
kids: Indoors: a four-story Grand Tree and light displays
You can bring a stroller, except in posted exhibits

kids.text: All-ages evening event Dec 19 (the Dec 10 one is 21+)

events.extra: Food; check parking on the museum's page.

watch.text: Naughty or Nice: All Ages Edition is an evening event on Dec 19. The Dec 10 one is 21+.

watch: Check hours on the museum's page.

events.name: McCormick Tribune Ice Rink
events.cost_note: Admission is free and rentals cost extra, per the city's tourism board, which lists no rental price.
events.watch: Check hours and the rental price on the city's rink page.

events.name: ZooLights
events.dates: Nov 20, 2026 to Jan 3, 2027, 4:30 to 9 p.m. Closed Nov 26, Dec 8, 15, 24, 25
events.cost_basis: $7 to $12 each, bought ahead, everyone needs a ticket

kids.text: Free Mondays with a reservation: Nov 23, 30, Dec 7, 14. Tickets release a week ahead, 11 a.m. CT
Santa nightly through Dec 23; photos cost extra

kids: Last entry 8 p.m. Strollers and wagons allowed; crowded nights can be hard

kids.text: Sensory-friendly night: Tue Nov 24, lights static or slowed, music softer

events.extra: Parking, limited and paid, price not listed.
events.cost_note: Every person needs a ticket, including babies. The page doesn't say which dates cost what.
events.cost_priced: $7 to $12 bought ahead, by date; $20 on the day or for a flexible ticket.

watch.text: Check Dec 1 before you plan it: the zoo's page lists it as closed in one place but not another.
Dec 21 and 28 are not free Mondays.

events.name: Illumination at The Morton Arboretum
events.cost_basis: 4 at the $22 adult starting price; no child price is listed, and prices vary by date and time
events.table_cost_note: from, if kids pay the adult price
kids: A one-mile paved trail the arboretum says strollers can roll on
Kids from age 4 count as a ticket on the AnyDay ticket

kids.text: Sensory night: Tue Nov 17, static lights, low music

events.extra: Pine Whistle Railroad $9, age 3 and under free; premium parking $18 a car.
events.extra_stale: Train ride and premium parking cost extra; check live.
events.cost_note: Prices vary by day and time, and buying ahead costs less.
events.cost_priced: Adults start at $22. Cheaper tickets on select nights for EBT, LINK and WIC cardholders: $10 adult, $5 child.
events.watch: You can't reach the trail until your ticket's entry time.
events.cost_read: price from Oct 1 release, read Nov 4

events.name: Wintrust Winter WonderFest
events.dates: Nov 27, 2026 to Jan 3, 2027, from 10 a.m.; closing time varies. Closed Dec 25; Nov 30 to Dec 2 not listed
events.cost_basis: $27 online a day ahead, $32 at the door, age 3 and up
kids: In Festival Hall, with an indoor rink: skating is in every ticket
events.extra_stale: The Centennial Wheel costs extra; check live.
events.cost_note: Children 2 and under are free; everyone 3 and up needs a ticket.
events.cost_priced: $27 online at least 24 hours ahead; $32 later or at the door.
events.watch: Some dates close at 5 p.m., as do Dec 24 and 31. The page doesn't mention strollers or Santa.

events.name: Holiday Magic
events.dates: Select dates Nov 21, 2026 to Jan 3, 2027, 3 to 9 p.m. Not listed: Nov 26, Nov 30 to Dec 2, Dec 7 to 9, Dec 14 to 16, Dec 24, 25
events.cost_basis: 4 at the $29.95 starting price; the page shows no child price

kids.text: Santa is included on listed dates, through Dec 23

kids: Light tunnels, a maze and a carousel, weather permitting

kids.text: Sensory night: Thu Dec 3, dimmer lights, softer music

events.extra: Penguin Encounter and igloo rentals; parking price not listed.
events.cost_note: The page shows one starting price, not adult and child prices.
events.watch: The tourism board says Nov 20, but the zoo's page starts Nov 21, so we use the zoo's. Stroller rules aren't listed.

chicago.hero_place: The Chicago Christmas tree, Millennium Park, December 2017, an older photo, not this season.
